newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BANK PEKAO SEEKS INSURER PZU STAKE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BANK PEKAO SEEKS INSURER PZU STAKE.

text.p: Poland's Bank Pekao SA and computer firm Prokom seek a stake in Poland's largest insurer Powszechny Zaklad Ubezpieczen SA (PZU) at its privatisation expected at the end of July, a PZU deputy president said.

"I confirm that those firms are interested in taking part in the privatisation of PZU SA, but there are also many other candidates from both home and abroad," Elzbieta Turkowska- Tyrluk told a news conference on Monday.

Prokom is one of Poland's largest computer systems suppliers while the privatisation of the Pekao group is due next year. The media have signalled they were on the list of prospective investors but so far the companies would not confirm the reports.
Turkowska-Tyrluk said potential investors were not taken aback by PZU's estimate it would have to pay 320 million zlotys in claims linked with the current flooding in Poland.
PZU has said that information memorandums were sent to four foreign and domestic groups which formed from 21 entities interested in PZU shares.
